CVE-2026-104935.description: Authentication bypass by spoofing in ICS before version 25.1.3.0 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. This does not impact ICS version 22.7R2.14 or prior.

kev.required_action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
kev.vulnerability_name: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability

CVE-2026-104935.summary_ko: 25.1.3.0 버전 미만의 ICS에서 스푸핑을 통한 인증 우회 취약점이 존재하여, 원격의 인증되지 않은 공격자가 임의 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: CISA KEV에 등재되어 실제 악용이 확인된 Ivanti 인증 우회 취약점입니다.

CVE-2026-94603.description: Podman is a tool for managing OCI containers and pods. From 4.4.0 until 5.8.8 and 6.1.3, podman run treats an image carrying the io.podman.annotations.checkpoint.runtime.name annotation as a checkpoint and silently ignores user-supplied container creation restrictions such as --cap-drop=ALL, allowing image-controlled checkpoint state to select weaker sandbox settings and capabilities. Rootless containers are not affected because checkpoint and restore are unavailable in that mode. This issue is fixed in versions 5.8.8 and 6.1.3.
CVE-2026-94603.summary_ko: Podman이 특정 체크포인트 어노테이션이 포함된 이미지를 처리할 때 사용자 제공 컨테이너 생성 제한을 무시하여 약한 샌드박스 설정과 기능을 선택할 수 있게 합니다.

curation.reason_ko: Podman에서 샌드박스 보안 제한을 무력화할 수 있는 심각도 10.0의 취약점입니다.

CVE-2026-103849.description: Adobe Commerce is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed.
CVE-2026-103849.summary_ko: Adobe Commerce는 템플릿 엔진에서 사용되는 특수 요소의 부적절한 무력화 취약점의 영향을 받아, 임의 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: 사용자 개입 없이 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있는 Adobe Commerce 심각도 10.0 결함입니다.

CVE-2026-110130.description: Dockhand before 1.0.45 contains an authentication bypass in which the global auth hook skips authentication for any path ending in a static-asset extension such as .js, including /api/* routes, and the user-mutation handlers fail open for unauthenticated callers. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send a PUT request to /api/users/<id>.js to reset the admin's or any user's password and take over the account.
CVE-2026-110130.summary_ko: 1.0.45 버전 미만의 Dockhand는 글로벌 인증 훅이 정적 자산 확장자로 끝나는 경로의 인증을 건너뛰고 사용자 변경 핸들러가 개방되어 있어 공격자가 관리자 비밀번호를 재설정할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: 정적 자산 검사 결함으로 원격에서 계정을 탈취할 수 있는 심각도 10.0의 인증 우회 취약점입니다.

CVE-2026-77459.description: Argo CD is a declarative, GitOps continuous delivery tool for Kubernetes. From 2.10.0 until 3.3.15, 3.4.10, 3.5.4, and 3.6.0-rc2, Argo CD creates PostDelete resource hooks without applying the AppProject destination and resource authorization checks used during ordinary synchronization. The omitted checks include cluster-scoped and namespaced resource allow/deny lists. A user who can write to an Application's Git repository can commit a delete hook targeting a forbidden namespace, server, group, kind, or resource name, and deletion of the Application causes the application-controller to create that resource with its destination-cluster credentials. The reachable impact is bounded by the controller's cluster access but can include cluster-scoped resources, disallowed namespaces, persistent hook objects, and secondary objects created by a hook Job. PreSync, Sync, PostSync, and SyncFail hooks continue to use the normal project checks. This issue is fixed in versions 3.3.15, 3.4.10, 3.5.4, and 3.6.0-rc2.
CVE-2026-77459.summary_ko: Argo CD에서 PostDelete 리소스 훅 생성 시 AppProject 대상 및 리소스 권한 부여 검사를 누락하여 애플리케이션 삭제 시 제한된 네임스페이스나 클러스터 리소스를 생성할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Argo CD 리소스 삭제 훅 검증 누락으로 클러스터 수준 권한을 획득할 수 있는 취약점입니다.

CVE-2026-105445.description: An Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in Docker Hub's account-to-organization conversion feature allowed an authenticated attacker to reassign a personal access token (PAT) they controlled to another Docker Hub user without rotating or revoking the token secret. The unchanged PAT then authenticated to the registry as the recipient and could pull, push, or delete images, within its scopes, in repositories accessible to that user, including organization repositories.
CVE-2026-105445.summary_ko: Docker Hub의 계정-조직 전환 기능에서 잘못된 권한 할당 취약점이 발생하여, 인증된 공격자가 토큰 비밀을 변경하지 않고도 제어하던 개인용 액세스 토큰을 다른 사용자에게 재할당할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Docker Hub 전환 기능 오류로 비인가 토큰 재할당 및 이미지 침해가 가능한 취약점입니다.

CVE-2026-70024.description: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows Internet Information Services allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CVE-2026-70024.summary_ko: Windows 인터넷 정보 서비스(IIS)의 스택 기반 버퍼 오버플로우 취약점으로 인해 권한이 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Windows IIS에서 원격으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있는 치명적인 버퍼 오버플로우 결함입니다.

CVE-2026-100202.description: Use after free in Windows Message Queuing Queue Manager allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CVE-2026-100202.summary_ko: Windows 메시지 큐 큐 관리자의 UAF(Use After Free) 취약점으로 인해 권한이 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Windows MSMQ Queue Manager에서 네트워크를 통해 원격 코드 실행이 가능한 UAF 결함입니다.

CVE-2026-83910.description: Out-of-bounds write in RPC Runtime allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CVE-2026-83910.summary_ko: RPC Runtime의 범위를 벗어난 쓰기(Out-of-bounds write) 취약점으로 인해 인증되지 않은 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Windows RPC 런타임에서 인증 없이 원격 코드를 실행할 수 있는 메모리 손상 취약점입니다.

CVE-2026-96113.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in DNS Server allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CVE-2026-96113.summary_ko: DNS 서버의 힙 기반 버퍼 오버플로우 취약점으로 인해 권한이 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Windows DNS 서버에서 인증 없이 원격 코드를 실행할 수 있는 버퍼 오버플로우 결함입니다.

CVE-2026-96219.description: Out-of-bounds write in Windows Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS) allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CVE-2026-96219.summary_ko: Windows 로컬 보안 권한 하위 시스템 서비스(LSASS)의 범위를 벗어난 쓰기 취약점으로 인해 권한이 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Windows 핵심 인증 프로세스인 LSASS에서 원격 코드를 실행할 수 있는 취약점입니다.

CVE-2026-85792.description: Remote Code Execution in Windows Routing and Remote Access Service (RRAS) allows attacker to gain an unauthorized access to victim's machine
CVE-2026-85792.summary_ko: Windows 라우팅 및 원격 액세스 서비스(RRAS)의 원격 코드 실행 취약점으로 인해 공격자가 피해자 시스템에 대한 무단 접근 권한을 획득할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Windows RRAS 서비스에서 시스템 무단 제어가 가능한 원격 코드 실행 취약점입니다.

CVE-2026-97016.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office Outlook allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CVE-2026-97016.summary_ko: Microsoft Office Outlook의 힙 기반 버퍼 오버플로우 취약점으로 인해 인증되지 않은 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Microsoft Outlook에서 인증 없이 원격 코드를 실행할 수 있는 치명적인 메모리 결함입니다.

CVE-2026-106173.description: A improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiSIEM 7.5.0 may allow attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.
CVE-2026-106173.summary_ko: Fortinet FortiSIEM 7.5.0의 경로 순회 취약점으로 인해 공격자가 특수 제작된 패킷을 통해 권한 없는 코드나 명령을 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Fortinet FortiSIEM에서 특수 제작된 패킷을 통해 원격 명령을 실행할 수 있는 결함입니다.

CVE-2026-100219.description: Use after free in Microsoft QUIC allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CVE-2026-100219.summary_ko: Microsoft QUIC의 힙 사용 후 해제(Use-after-free) 취약점으로 인해 인증되지 않은 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Microsoft QUIC 프로토콜 구현체에서 원격 코드를 실행할 수 있는 UAF 취약점입니다.

CVE-2026-103928.description: Metabase is an open source business intelligence and analytics platform. From 1.55.0 until 1.58.16, 1.59.13, 1.60.9, and 1.61.4, native queries and actions against an H2 data source are passed through without restricting host-facing built-in functions. A user authorized to run native queries or actions can invoke FILE_READ, FILE_WRITE, CSVREAD, CSVWRITE, or LINK_SCHEMA to read or write arbitrary files on the Metabase server or link other databases. The default sample database uses H2, so the vulnerable surface is exposed by default. This issue is fixed in versions 1.58.16, 1.59.13, 1.60.9, and 1.61.4.
CVE-2026-103928.summary_ko: Metabase의 H2 데이터 소스 관련 네이티브 쿼리 및 액션 처리에서 호스트 내장 함수 제한이 누락되어, 권한 있는 사용자가 임의 파일을 읽거나 쓸 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Metabase의 H2 내장 함수 제한 누락으로 기본 설치 상태에서 임의 파일 입출력이 가능합니다.

CVE-2026-69227.description: A flaw in Portal for ArcGIS allows unauthenticated access to certain /portaladmin/local API endpoints under specific conditions. This could enable an attacker to access administrative functionality that should require authentication.
CVE-2026-69227.summary_ko: Portal for ArcGIS의 결함으로 인해 특정 조건에서 인증되지 않은 사용자가 특정 관리 API 엔드포인트에 접근할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Portal for ArcGIS 관리 API 엔드포인트에 인증 없이 직접 접근할 수 있는 결함입니다.

CVE-2026-53709.description: MCP Context Forge is an MCP gateway and administrative platform. Prior to 1.0.2, mcpgateway/config.py and .env.example ship a known JWT_SECRET_KEY, while verify_jwt_token() accepts HS256 tokens signed with that key and get_current_user() creates a platform administrator when the token subject matches PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAIL and REQUIRE_USER_IN_DB is false. A remote unauthenticated attacker can therefore mint accepted administrator tokens without a database account. While the vulnerable signing key remains configured and the platform-admin bootstrap remains enabled, forged access survives password rotation, account deletion, and session revocation, allowing administrative disclosure, modification, and service disruption. This issue is fixed in version 1.0.2.
CVE-2026-53709.summary_ko: MCP Context Forge에서 기본 설정된 알려진 JWT_SECRET_KEY와 인증 로직으로 인해 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 관리자 토큰을 위조하여 플랫폼 관리자 권한을 획득할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: 기본 시크릿 키 노출로 원격 공격자가 관리자 토큰을 위조할 수 있는 게이트웨이 취약점입니다.

CVE-2026-70279.description: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') in Microsoft Exchange Server allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.
CVE-2026-70279.summary_ko: Microsoft Exchange Server의 웹 페이지 생성 중 입력값 부적절 검증(크로스 사이트 스크립팅)으로 인해 인증되지 않은 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 스푸핑을 수행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Microsoft Exchange Server에서 스푸핑 공격을 유발할 수 있는 치명적인 XSS 결함입니다.

CVE-2026-96252.description: Improper verification of cryptographic signature in Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network.
CVE-2026-96252.summary_ko: Active Directory Federation Services(AD FS)의 암호화 서명 부적절 검증으로 인해 인증되지 않은 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 스푸핑을 수행할 수 있습니다.

curation.reason_ko: Active Directory Federation Services에서 서명 검증 오류로 스푸핑이 가능한 취약점입니다.

4a89e4a33ab56bb4c80c4533.title_original: Microsoft Patches More Than 1,400 Security Flaws
4a89e4a33ab56bb4c80c4533.excerpt: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. Today’s epic patch batch dwarfs September’s record of nearly 1,000 fixes, which was already about ten times the normal monthly patch load from Redmond. Just one of the weaknesses patched this week is considered a “zero day,” or already exploited in the wild. CVE-2026-96951 is a security feature bypass in the Windows Shell that affects Windows 10 and 11 systems, as well as some Server versions. Windows 10 users might be wondering if they can still expect security updates after this month. Microsoft had been slated to stop shipping updates for Windows 10 systems in October 2025, but ended up adding another year of free updates after considerable pushback. A few months ago, Microsoft quietly extended that support for another year (until October 2027). At least 78 of the flaws fixed this month are rated “critical,” meaning they could be exploited with little or no action by the user, and most of those critical bugs allow an attacker to execute code of their choice on the vulnerable system. While Microsoft said there are no signs anyone is exploiting it yet, a security feature bypass in the .NET Framework ( CVE-2026-108398 ) was publicly disclosed prior to today, potentially giving attackers advance time to work out how to exploit the bug. Satnam Narang at Tenable said the number of flaws fixed this month far surpasses the previous record-setting year

CVE-2024-34319.description: A Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in the serviceURL parameter of ProPhoenix Law RMS v2022.2403.3.101 allows attackers to force the application server to make unintended DNS and web requests via a crafted HTTP request.

CVE-2026-102250.description: CWE-345: Insufficient Verification of Data Authenticity vulnerability exists that could allow modified firmware to be uploaded when an authorized admin user begins a firmware update procedure which could result in control over the device.

CVE-2026-102342.description: ammonia is a Rust library for repairing and securing untrusted HTML. Prior to 3.3.3, 4.0.3, and 4.1.4, applications that allow the SVG animate or set elements can retain an animation whose attributeName targets href and whose value uses the javascript scheme. The sanitized SVG can therefore create a script-bearing link, and a user who clicks the link can execute attacker-controlled script in the application's origin, enabling stored cross-site scripting. This issue is fixed in versions 3.3.3, 4.0.3, and 4.1.4.

CVE-2026-102603.description: Gotify server is a simple server for sending and receiving messages in real-time per WebSocket. Prior to 3.0.0, the password change endpoint (POST /current/user/password) accepts a valid client token without requiring the account's current password or another elevated authentication step. An attacker who obtains a client token can set a new password for the associated user, taking control of password authentication and forcing account recovery through an administrator or direct database access. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.0.

CVE-2026-103028.description: SFTPGo is an open source, event-driven file transfer solution. From 2.5.0 until 2.7.6, an authenticated user with copy permission can copy a source file denied by denied_patterns or outside allowed_patterns to an allowed destination name because file-pattern filters are evaluated only on the destination. The user can then read the denied file contents. Recursive directory copies can reproduce restricted contents under an allowed path, and the hide policy is bypassed because files that appear missing to stat and directory listings can still be copied. Home-directory boundaries, virtual-folder layout, per-directory permissions, access to other accounts, and administrative authorization remain enforced. This issue is fixed in 2.7.6.

CVE-2026-104192.description: Dragonfly is an in-memory data store built for modern application workloads. Prior to 1.40, OpaqueObjLoader::CreateStream in src/server/rdb_load.cc can associate one streamNACK with a consumer group's global PEL and a consumer-local PEL, then free the shared object when a duplicate consumer entry is rejected. Cleanup subsequently frees the same object again. In the default configuration, where Dragonfly ships with authentication disabled, an unauthenticated client can trigger the double-free by sending a crafted serialized stream to RESTORE, causing allocator corruption, denial of service, and potentially attacker-controlled code execution as the Dragonfly service account. The source fix has not yet been mapped to a published release.

CVE-2026-106108.description: Quasar Framework is a framework for building high-performance Vue.js user interfaces. From 3.1.0 until 3.3.0, @quasar/app-vite SSG page definitions returned by getSsgPages() could supply dir and filename values that were joined to build.distDir without verifying the final destination. Parent traversal or an existing symlink below the distribution directory could create new HTML files or directories outside the output tree with the build user's permissions. Application configuration and SSG page definitions are trusted by default, so exploitation requires a build process that derives them from external or otherwise less-trusted content; existing files remain protected by the renderer's no-overwrite behavior. This issue is fixed in version 3.3.0.

CVE-2026-107460.description: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) protection in the UrlImageConverter component of Apache Fesod (Incubating) fesod-sheet 2.0.2-incubating can be bypassed through DNS rebinding. When an application accepts an attacker-controlled image URL for spreadsheet writing, the converter checks the hostname's resolved IP addresses and then opens a separate connection that can resolve the hostname again. An attacker who controls DNS responses for the URL hostname may cause the connection to reach a restricted address after validation. CVE-2026-49328 covers SSRF in releases before 2.0.2-incubating; this issue is a DNS rebinding bypass of the protection in 2.0.2-incubating. Apache Fesod (Incubating) 2.1.0-incubating addresses the reported default-fetch scenario by disabling remote URL image fetching by default and requiring an explicit exact-host allowlist when the feature is enabled. Users should upgrade to 2.1.0-incubating. Applications enabling remote URL image fetching should allowlist only hostnames whose DNS and HTTP services are trusted.

CVE-2026-53709.description: MCP Context Forge is an MCP gateway and administrative platform. Prior to 1.0.2, mcpgateway/config.py and .env.example ship a known JWT_SECRET_KEY, while verify_jwt_token() accepts HS256 tokens signed with that key and get_current_user() creates a platform administrator when the token subject matches PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAIL and REQUIRE_USER_IN_DB is false. A remote unauthenticated attacker can therefore mint accepted administrator tokens without a database account. While the vulnerable signing key remains configured and the platform-admin bootstrap remains enabled, forged access survives password rotation, account deletion, and session revocation, allowing administrative disclosure, modification, and service disruption. This issue is fixed in version 1.0.2.
CVE-2026-53709.summary_ko: MCP Context Forge에서 기본 설정된 알려진 JWT_SECRET_KEY와 인증 로직으로 인해 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 관리자 토큰을 위조하여 플랫폼 관리자 권한을 획득할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-53711.description: MCP Context Forge provides an MCP Admin UI for managing gateway resources. From 0.2.0 until 0.3.1, the Global Prompts feature stores a prompt template without sufficient output encoding before the MCP Admin UI renders it. An authenticated attacker can save markup containing script-capable event handlers, and the code executes when another user views the saved prompt. The stored cross-site scripting can alter the interface, present phishing content, observe keystrokes available to the page, and act with the viewer's browser session. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.1.

CVE-2026-65197.description: H3C HDM Family-A verifies the RSA signature of a firmware image against a public key it reads from the mutable file `/conf/public.pem`. That file is writable by an authenticated Redfish client through the `UpdateService.UploadSignKey` action, which stores the uploaded body verbatim after validating only that the multipart filename ends in `.pem`. An administrator, or any account with `firmware-update` privilege, can therefore replace the trust anchor with their own key, sign a malicious image with the matching private key, and have it pass verification. Family-A has no hardware root-of-trust (no PFR) to catch the substituted key. This was observed on H3C HDM Family-A G5 HDM 6.14.01. H3C HDM Family-A G3/G5 builds carrying the Redfish/DRE update tree appear to be affected. HDM2 uses a different update path and is not covered by this finding.

CVE-2026-65198.description: Huawei's openUBMC ships a default SNMPv3 USM key that uses one value for both authentication and privacy. An attacker who holds the key (recoverable from the open-source build) can authenticate SNMPv3 to, and decrypt SNMPv3 traffic from, any unit that still carries the shipped key. The build customization `manifest/build/customization/default_password.lua` sets `AuthenticationKey == EncryptionKey == 7df2f29369e3ac3245b2c9d46b67a0ecd055197e41808a34ef325db2f6422581` for the iBMC product build, and the community seed `account/manufacture/default_password.lua` sets both to `7a2f5b86f20233ec7b7bef49643fbf34d86d0cbf6f1f8f5c52d4f30d4536938b`. These are shipped constants, not per-unit values, and they are not rotated by the Administrator password reset, so they survive account provisioning. This is especially dangerous considering that SNMP access is mapped to full device administration privileges, including system reset and firmware upgrades.

CVE-2026-65199.description: openUBMC assigns the full privilege set to pseudo-identities representing SNMP callers. An authenticated, but low-privilege, SNMP user can therefore invoke mapped backend operations as an administrative identity. In `route_mapper/account.lua`, `get_user_privilege` returns the complete nine-privilege set for a `special_users` group that includes the `SNMPv1_v2c` pseudo-user.

CVE-2026-65200.description: The openUBMC device-management process parses PLDM-over-MCTP and NCSI-over-MCTP responses from on-bus devices, and three response parsers in the shared transport libraries subtract a fixed header or reserved-field size from a device-supplied response length without a lower-bound check. An undersized response wraps the unsigned length difference to a very large value, and the parser then reads far past the response buffer. The affected code sits in the base (non-vendor) PLDM control class and the Huawei NCSI driver, so it is reachable for any PLDM endpoint or Huawei NIC on the internal management bus, unlike the vendor-specific wangxun parser tracked separately.

CVE-2026-77096.description: CVFS contained a missing authentication condition affecting command execution. Software customers upgrade to resolved maintenance release. Update CVFS.

CVE-2026-77099.description: CVFS contained an input validation issue affecting command execution. Software customers upgrade to resolved maintenance release. Update CVFS.

CVE-2026-77100.description: MediaAgent contained a heap-based buffer overflow issue affecting service availability. Software customers upgrade to resolved maintenance release. Update Commvault installation of MediaAgents and HyperScale.

CVE-2026-77375.description: SFTPGo is an open source, event-driven file transfer solution. Prior to 2.7.5, an authenticated SSH user can send a malformed protocol message while opening a channel, causing an unhandled error that terminates the server process and affects all connected users until restart. No confidentiality or integrity impact has been identified. This issue is fixed in 2.7.5.

CVE-2026-95114.description: libwebsockets contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the LEJP incremental parser in lib/misc/lejp.c. This allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service

CVE-2026-95115.description: Buffer Overflow vulnerability in libwebsockets main 106d542c allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service via the LEJP JSON parser

CVE-2026-95117.description: Buffer Overflow vulnerability in zserge jsmn jsmn HEAD 25647e6 allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service via the jsmn.h, jsmn_parse(), example/jsondump.c, dump() components

CVE-2026-95121.description: An issue in mp4v2 2.0.0 allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code via the MP4RtpAtom::ReadHntiType() in src/atom_rtp.cpp. A specially crafted MP4 file can cause an undersized rtp atom to produce a near-2^64 allocation size through an unchecked offset subtraction

CVE-2026-95122.description: mp4v2 2.0.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in MP4File::GenerateTracks() in src/mp4file.cpp. This allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service

CVE-2026-95124.description: Buffer Overflow vulnerability in madmurphy libconfini v.1.16.4 allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service via an allocation-size mismatch between its bundled load_ini_buffer utility and strip_ini_cache()

CVE-2026-95127.description: An issue in libass v.0.17.5 allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service via the ass_outline_construct() in libass/ass_render.c

CVE-2026-97333.description: QAPI contained a stack-based buffer overflow affecting service availability. Software customers upgrade to resolved maintenance release. Update CommServe, Web Server, Command Center and Index Server.

CVE-2026-97334.description: The network messaging layer contained improper handling of highly compressed data affecting service availability. Software customers upgrade to resolved maintenance release. Update all Commvault installations, including CommServe server, Web Server, Command Center, MediaAgents, clients, and HyperScale.

CVE-2026-9218.description: Insufficient input validation vulnerability in time server (NTP) setting of the listed NETGEAR models allows an attacker who is connected to the router’s local network and has the router’s administrator credentials to run unauthorized commands on the router. This vulnerability could impact the integrity of the affected router. There is no impact on confidentiality or availability of the affected router.

CVE-2024-34320.description: ProPhoenix Law RMS v2022.2403.3.101 was discovered to contain an incorrect access control issue in sensitive API endpoints.

CVE-2024-34321.description: ProPhoenix Law RMS v2022.2403.3.101 was discovered to contain a reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the PageTitle/Notes parameter in the Notes.aspx endpoint.

CVE-2024-34323.description: ProPhoenix Law RMS v2022.2403.3.101 was discovered to contain an Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) via the usrLogin$hdnPFID parameter. This vulnerability allows attackers to access sensitive information via a crafted HTTP request.

CVE-2024-34324.description: An issue in ProPhoenix Law RMS v2022.2403.3.101 allows attackers to execute a session hijacking attack via injecting a crafted 24-character string into the ASP.NET_SessionId cookie.

CVE-2024-34326.description: ProPhoenix Law RMS v2022.2403.3.101 was discovered to contain a reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability via the PageTitle/Alert/MsgType parameter in the errorHandler.aspx endpoint.

CVE-2026-101899.description: Axios is a promise-based HTTP client for the browser and Node.js. From 1.15.0 until 1.20.0, Axios shouldBypassProxy treats the NO_PROXY CIDR form as a textual hostname suffix instead of evaluating the network range. A request targets an address covered by a CIDR entry in NO_PROXY while a proxy is configured. The CIDR bypass rule is not matched, so the request is sent through the configured proxy. For plaintext HTTP, the proxy can observe and modify URLs, headers, and bodies; for HTTPS, it can observe connection metadata and CONNECT requests. This issue is fixed in version 1.20.0.

CVE-2026-102672.description: Electron is a framework for writing cross-platform desktop applications using JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Prior to 39.8.10, 41.10.5, and 42.0.0-beta.2, Electron applications on macOS that use Squirrel.Mac-based automatic updates are vulnerable to a local race in the privileged ShipIt helper. The helper did not bind the validated update target to one canonical application-bundle path for the full installation, allowing a local attacker to redirect the root-level write so that it overwrites another application's files instead of the application that initiated the update. Applications on other platforms and macOS applications that do not use Squirrel.Mac-based automatic updates are not affected. This issue is fixed in versions 39.8.10, 41.10.5, and 42.0.0-beta.2.

CVE-2026-102699.description: [This CNA information record relates to multiple CVEs; the text explains which aspects/vulnerabilities correspond to which CVE.] 1) XSA-437 (CVE-2023-34321) addressed issues with overflows in calculations involved in guests flushing caches through GNTTABOP_cache_flush. Unfortunately the fix there introduced a calculation which may underflow, resulting in a loop which would - at least on 64-bit Arm - take excessively long, and which would likely eventually crash the hypervisor. This is CVE-2026-102699. 2) GNTTABOP_cache_flush may be issued on memory mapped from another domain using the grant table interface. However there was no restriction to disallow the use of invalidate-without-clean against read-only grant mappings, which may corrupt the granted memory. This is CVE-2026-102702.

CVE-2026-102700.description: With its original introduction, GNTTAB_cache_flush was made available uniformly. XSA-232 (CVE-2017-14318) then covered an omitted NULL pointer check, yet the addition of that check failed to adjust the subsequent error path. That error path fails to drop a page reference in case the specified page is owned by a special system domain (DOM_IO and DOM_COW are system domains which can have memory pages assigned to them.)

CVE-2026-102702.description: [This CNA information record relates to multiple CVEs; the text explains which aspects/vulnerabilities correspond to which CVE.] 1) XSA-437 (CVE-2023-34321) addressed issues with overflows in calculations involved in guests flushing caches through GNTTABOP_cache_flush. Unfortunately the fix there introduced a calculation which may underflow, resulting in a loop which would - at least on 64-bit Arm - take excessively long, and which would likely eventually crash the hypervisor. This is CVE-2026-102699. 2) GNTTABOP_cache_flush may be issued on memory mapped from another domain using the grant table interface. However there was no restriction to disallow the use of invalidate-without-clean against read-only grant mappings, which may corrupt the granted memory. This is CVE-2026-102702.

CVE-2026-102734.description: asteval is a Python expression evaluator designed for restricted execution. Prior to 1.0.9, in asteval/astutils.py, the default Interpreter with numpy enabled exposes a ctypes type and permits from_address memory access. safe_getattr blocks the ctypes module but not reachable ctypes type objects, while attribute assignments use unfiltered setattr instead of safe_setattr. An attacker-controlled expression can derive an address with id, read memory through from_address, and write through an attribute assignment. The expression can read or corrupt arbitrary process memory, escape the intended sandbox, execute code, disclose secrets, or crash the host process. This issue is fixed in version 1.0.9.

CVE-2026-102832.description: JupyterLab is an extensible environment for interactive and reproducible computing, based on the Jupyter Notebook Architecture. From 4.5.7 until 4.5.11 and 4.6.4, the markdownviewer:trust and notebook:trust command-link handlers use tracker.currentWidget to resolve the current Markdown viewer or notebook when the user answers rather than retaining the document whose command button was clicked. If another document becomes current while the prompt is open and the user chooses Trust, JupyterLab marks the second document trusted while leaving the clicked document untrusted. Later command buttons in the incorrectly trusted document run without a prompt, and trusting a notebook marks all cells trusted, saves unsaved edits, and persists the server signature to disk. Applications that bundle JupyterLab, including affected Notebook and JupyterLite releases, inherit the behavior. This issue is fixed in versions 4.5.11 and 4.6.4.

CVE-2026-102981.description: Plane is an open-source project management tool. Prior to 1.4.0, self-hosted Plane deployments allow unauthenticated GET requests to api/workspaces/{slug}/invitations/{pk}/join/ through WorkspaceJoinEndpoint, whose WorkSpaceMemberInviteSerializer exposes the secret invitation token directly and through get_invite_link. An external attacker can retrieve a token intended for another user and submit it to the invitation acceptance flow, joining the workspace without receiving the invitation and gaining the role assigned to the invite. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.0.

CVE-2026-102982.description: Plane is an open-source project management tool. Prior to 1.4.0, the plane comments fail to sanitize unsafe URL schemes stored in comment_html. A project member can store a crafted link in a comment, and attacker-controlled script executes in the browser context of another user who selects the link. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.0.

CVE-2026-102988.description: Plane is an open-source project management tool. Prior to 1.4.0, multiple issue-listing endpoints, including unauthenticated public deploy boards handled by IssueListSpaceEndpoint in apps/api/plane/space/views/issue.py, pass the user-controlled order_by parameter through order_issue_queryset in apps/api/plane/utils/order_queryset.py to Django's order_by without allowlist validation. An attacker can use double-underscore relationship traversal to reference arbitrary related model fields, revealing database schema details through errors and potentially disclosing field values through differential ordering. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.0.

CVE-2026-103928.description: Metabase is an open source business intelligence and analytics platform. From 1.55.0 until 1.58.16, 1.59.13, 1.60.9, and 1.61.4, native queries and actions against an H2 data source are passed through without restricting host-facing built-in functions. A user authorized to run native queries or actions can invoke FILE_READ, FILE_WRITE, CSVREAD, CSVWRITE, or LINK_SCHEMA to read or write arbitrary files on the Metabase server or link other databases. The default sample database uses H2, so the vulnerable surface is exposed by default. This issue is fixed in versions 1.58.16, 1.59.13, 1.60.9, and 1.61.4.
CVE-2026-103928.summary_ko: Metabase의 H2 데이터 소스 관련 네이티브 쿼리 및 액션 처리에서 호스트 내장 함수 제한이 누락되어, 권한 있는 사용자가 임의 파일을 읽거나 쓸 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-103965.description: An issue in MongoDB Server's aggregation framework can cause certain constant values to be handled incorrectly during internal query rewriting. Under certain conditions, an authenticated user with read access may receive field values in aggregation output that the query did not intend to return.

CVE-2026-104004.description: MongoDB Server's collection validation feature may not properly handle certain expressions stored in a validator. In some cases, this can cause the server process to stop running when a document is later inserted. The behavior can occur for authenticated users with write access.

CVE-2026-104005.description: A security issue was discovered in MongoDB mongos (the sharded cluster router) where an authenticated user with readWrite privileges could crash the mongos process by crafting a specially formed aggregation pipeline. The issue leverages an internal aggregation stage that lacks proper authorization checks despite being intended for internal use, allowing a subsequent stage to be forced to execute on the router under conditions it was not designed to handle. This results in an unhandled fatal error that causes the mongos process to immediately abort, resulting in denial of service for all clients routed through the affected mongos instance.

CVE-2026-104935.description: Authentication bypass by spoofing in ICS before version 25.1.3.0 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands. This does not impact ICS version 22.7R2.14 or prior.

CVE-2026-109524.description: A vulnerability was determined in girishsaraf Online-Appointment-Booking-System up to f427b4757128ca253d33d0cc4e87bbb9c999a4d5.
