CVE-2026-110202.description: Roo Code through 3.54.0 contains a command approval bypass vulnerability in getCommandDecision() that allows attackers to auto-approve denied shell commands by prefixing them with a bare >& redirect. Attackers using indirect prompt injection can make the allowlist match a redirect target like echo while the shell runs the denied command on the developer machine.

CVE-2026-110203.description: Roo Code through 3.54.0 contains a command approval bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to auto-approve denied shell commands by abusing quote-masking regex in parseCommandLine(). Attackers can use indirect prompt injection with escaped or single-quoted double quotes to hide command separators behind allowlisted prefixes like echo, executing commands without user approval.

CVE-2026-110204.description: Roo Code through 3.54.0 contains a command approval bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to run denied shell commands because parseCommandLine() treats ${ command; } substitutions as parameter expansions. Attackers using indirect prompt injection can embed denied commands inside an allowlisted command like echo to execute them without user approval on bash 5.3+ or ksh93.

CVE-2026-110205.description: Roo Code through 3.54.0 contains a command approval bypass vulnerability in parseCommandLine() that discards command substitutions placed next to * or ? glob characters. Attackers using indirect prompt injection can craft commands like echo *$(...) that match allowlisted prefixes, executing denied commands without user approval when auto-approval is enabled.

CVE-2026-110206.description: Roo Code through 3.54.0 contains a command approval bypass vulnerability in parseCommandLine() that allows attackers to auto-approve arbitrary shell commands by placing a command substitution in command position. Attackers using indirect prompt injection can submit commands like $(echo touch /tmp/x) that pass the echo allowlist check, causing the shell to execute the output without user approval.

CVE-2026-110207.description: Wukong AICRM through 20260610 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to call user, role, department and agent administration APIs because no administrator check exists. Attackers can send POST requests to /managerUser/updateUser to reset the admin account's password and assign themselves the "all" role, achieving full administrator account takeover.

CVE-2026-110208.description: Wukong AICRM through 20260610 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the /systemConfig controller that allows any authenticated user to read the stored AI provider API key. Attackers can request GET /systemConfig/byType/ai for the cleartext key, or send a chosen apiUrl to /systemConfig/ai/test, forwarding the stored key to their host.

CVE-2026-110209.description: Stonewuu ai-fusion-video through 1.2.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated non-admin users to read stored secrets through unprotected ApiConfigController and SystemConfigController endpoints. Attackers can query the api-config get/list and system config endpoints to obtain AI provider API keys, proxy passwords and mail_password, enabling billing abuse and sending mail as the platform.

CVE-2026-110210.description: Phase Console through 2.77.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows organisation members without Secrets read permission to read secret history via the secretHistory GraphQL query. Attackers holding an environment key can supply a known secret identifier to retrieve encrypted secret events and decrypt values using their wrapped environment key.

CVE-2026-110211.description: iFlytek SkillHub through 0.2.22 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to permanently delete other users' skills via DELETE /api/cli/v1/skills/{namespace}/{slug}. Attackers can locate targets through the anonymous search endpoint and trigger deletion without ownership checks, purging all versions, files, reviews, ratings and metadata.

CVE-2026-110212.description: Stonewuu ai-fusion-video through 1.2.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write uploaded files outside the media directory via the subDir parameter of POST /api/storage/upload. Attackers can supply parent-directory sequences that LocalStorageStrategy.storeBytes never normalizes, creating directories and writing attacker-controlled files with chosen extensions anywhere the service account can write.

CVE-2026-110213.description: Stonewuu ai-fusion-video through 1.2.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read other users' generation results by supplying arbitrary task ids. Attackers can enumerate auto-increment task ids on the image and video /items endpoints to obtain other users' generated images, videos, and output metadata.

CVE-2026-110214.description: Snowy 3.6.5 contains a hard-coded HMAC key vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge download signatures for the /dev/file/download endpoint by using the published FILE_DOWNLOAD_SIGN_SECRET constant. Attackers can compute HMAC-SHA256 signatures of guessed file ids offline to download stored files such as avatars, editor images and attachments.

CVE-2026-110215.description: youlai-boot through 2.21.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to assign arbitrary menu and button permissions to roles via PUT /api/v1/roles/{roleId}/menus. Low-privileged users such as the GUEST test account can grant all permissions to their own role, refreshing the Redis permission cache to gain administrator-equivalent access.

CVE-2026-110216.description: youlai-boot through 2.21.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to enable or disable accounts because the updateUserStatus handler lacks a @PreAuthorize check. Attackers can send PATCH requests to /api/v1/users/{userId}/status to disable root or admin accounts, locking administrators out, or re-enable accounts an administrator has disabled.

CVE-2026-110217.description: Lenve vhr through commit 03abbd3 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to retrieve other operators' BCrypt password hashes via GET /chat/hrs. Low-privileged operators can collect administrator password hashes, phone numbers, and addresses from the serialized Hr entity for offline cracking and privilege escalation.

CVE-2026-110218.description: Aureus ERP through 1.6.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read unpublished draft blog posts via the customer-facing post view page. Attackers who know or guess a post slug can retrieve the full title, content, image, tags, author and publish date because PostResource skips authorization and ViewPost ignores is_published.

CVE-2026-110219.description: QloApps through 1.7.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject scripts through the price parameter of the back-office Additional Facilities form. Attackers can induce an authenticated back-office user to submit a crafted request whose unescaped price value is re-rendered after failing validation, executing JavaScript in the administrative session.

CVE-2026-110220.description: Kubeflow Model Registry through 0.3.17 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows namespace users to steal the controller ServiceAccount token via the modelregistry.kubeflow.org/url annotation. Attackers can create an InferenceService pointing the annotation at their server, capture the bearer token, and modify other tenants' InferenceServices cluster-wide.

CVE-2026-110221.description: QloApps through 1.7.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the AdminHotelFeaturePricesSettings form that echoes feature_price_name and impact_value POST values unescaped after validation fails. Attackers can lure an authenticated back-office user into submitting a crafted request via a malicious link or auto-submitting form, executing JavaScript in their administrative session.

CVE-2026-110222.description: Razorpay IFSC Ruby gem through 2.0.62 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to redirect API requests by supplying a crafted IFSC code to IFSC.find or IFSC#get. Attackers can submit network-path references or absolute URIs that URI.join resolves as a new host, sending GET requests to internal or attacker-chosen hosts and returning parsed response fields.

CVE-2026-110223.description: Kavita 0.9.0 through 0.9.1.4 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass the SSRF blocklist through DNS rebinding or HTTPS redirects. Attackers can submit a URL to POST /api/Cbl/upload-cbl-file whose host rebinds or redirects to internal addresses after validation, enabling blind internal port and service probing.

CVE-2026-110224.description: QloApps through 1.7.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in AdminSearchConfController::processSave() that echoes rejected alias and search values unescaped in validation errors. Attackers can induce an authenticated back-office user to submit a crafted request, executing JavaScript in that user's administrative session.

CVE-2026-110225.description: Shaarli through 0.16.9 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to make the server request internal addresses by fetching bookmark thumbnails without private-address checks. Attackers can create bookmarks pointing to loopback, private, or cloud metadata addresses and trigger ThumbnailsController::ajaxUpdate or saving to send blind GET requests, with open_shaarli exposing this to any visitor.

CVE-2026-110226.description: QloApps through 1.7.0 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows hotel-restricted back-office employees to create room types under unassigned hotels by supplying an arbitrary id_hotel. Attackers can enumerate all hotels via the unfiltered room type form selector and post foreign hotel IDs to AdminProductsController, creating rooms and inventory under other hotels.

CVE-2026-110228.description: wallabag 2.6.13 through 2.6.14 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users to host arbitrary HTML by triggering a failed Pocket HTML, Pocket CSV or Shaarli import. Attackers can upload an HTML file with script but no anchor elements, leaving it at the predictable /uploads/import/<user-id>.html path to execute script in victims' wallabag sessions.

CVE-2026-110229.description: QloApps through 1.7.0 contains an improper access control vulnerability in AdminSlipController that allows hotel-restricted back-office employees to access credit slips of all hotels. Attackers can list, export as PDF, mark as redeemed, and generate store-credit vouchers from other hotels' refund records, exposing customer identities and amounts.

CVE-2026-110230.description: XBackBone through 3.8.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to change other users' upload share codes via the POST /upload/{id}/vanity route. Attackers can supply sequential upload ids to MediaController::createVanity() to break existing share links and hijack the freed codes with their own uploads.

CVE-2026-110231.description: muCommander through 1.6.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in UnpackJob that allows attackers to write files outside the destination folder by bypassing its ZipSlip check with unnormalized remote paths. Attackers can craft TAR or ZIP entries like ../../.ssh/authorized_keys that, when extracted to FTP or SFTP folders, create or overwrite files writable by the user's remote account.

CVE-2026-110232.description: Fossify File Manager through 1.6.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows crafted ZIP archives to write files outside the extraction folder by bypassing an unanchored startsWith check. Attackers can supply archive entries like ../<name>_x/file to create or overwrite files in sibling folders when a user extracts the archive.

CVE-2026-110233.description: Rovr through 0.10.3 on Windows contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute commands by crafting malicious file names. Attackers can deliver a file named with shell metacharacters like & alongside a payload, which runs with user privileges when the file is opened through open_file.

CVE-2026-110234.description: Elio through 1.13.0 contains an insecure temporary file vulnerability that allows local users to overwrite another user's files by pre-creating symbolic links at predictable capture paths. Attackers who know the victim's Elio process ID can plant a symlink so previewing media, fonts or archives truncates and overwrites victim-owned files.

CVE-2026-110235.description: MP Manager through 1.1.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows attackers to write files outside the extraction folder by bypassing the non-recursive sanitizeEntryName filter. Attackers can craft TAR, 7z or RAR entries named ....//file that become ../file, creating or overwriting files anywhere the app can write on shared storage.

CVE-2026-110236.description: KDE Dolphin 24.08.0 through 26.08.2 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows attackers to execute commands by supplying crafted folder names substituted into the {path} placeholder. Attackers can embed a double quote and shell metacharacters in a directory name to escape quoting in slotDoubleClickViewBackground, executing commands when victims double-click the view background.

CVE-2026-110237.description: Vifm 0.8.1-beta through 0.14.4 reuses a pre-existing IPC FIFO in the shared temporary directory without checking ownership, allowing local users to execute commands as another user. Attackers can pre-create a world-writable vifm-ipc-vifm FIFO and write IPC packets with -c and ! shell commands that execute with the victim's privileges.

CVE-2026-110238.description: Rapyd Admin from 9.0.0 before 9.20.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated company members with the default customer role to modify or delete arbitrary user accounts through the UsersModalEditEmbed Livewire component. Attackers can dispatch editUser or deleteUser with predictable sequential user ids to reset owner or super admin passwords, promote themselves to owner, and delete users.

CVE-2026-110239.description: Rapyd Admin before 9.20.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the x-rpd::rich-text Blade component that outputs bound model values as raw HTML without sanitisation. Authenticated users can set the bound property through the Livewire client API to store JavaScript that executes when administrators open the record's form.

CVE-2026-110240.description: Lancet through 2.3.9 contains an SSRF protection bypass vulnerability in netutil.IsInternalIP that misclassifies IPv6 private, link-local, CGNAT and transition addresses as external. Attackers can supply hostnames resolving to these address forms, including NAT64, 6to4 or Teredo embedding internal IPv4, to reach internal services or cloud metadata endpoints.

CVE-2026-110247.description: Several buffer-growth sites in libmime performed size arithmetic in 32-bit types without overflow checks. On a sufficiently large message the growth guard could fail open, or the buffer could be reallocated smaller than required, and a subsequent memcpy would then write attacker-controlled data across adjacent heap allocations. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 158.

CVE-2026-110249.description: A malicious, compromised, or MITM-controlled Exchange server can return a single well-formed SOAP response containing an element with enough attributes to keep Thunderbird's main thread CPU-bound for seconds to hours. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 158 and Thunderbird 153.5.

CVE-2026-110254.description: Finsys Dockhand before 1.0.45 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the ipCategory() function in src/lib/server/url-safety.ts, which fails to check NAT64, 6to4, and Teredo IPv6 transition ranges. Authenticated attackers can embed loopback, cloud metadata, or private IPv4 addresses in transition IPv6 literals within notification, backup, template, registry, git, or secret provider URLs to reach internal services.

CVE-2026-110255.description: Finsys Dockhand before 1.0.43 contains a response-disclosing server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to make the server fetch arbitrary URLs by supplying repository URL and stackfile values. Attackers can send stack templates pointing to internal services or cloud metadata endpoints and read the fetched content from the compose response field, exposing credentials and tokens.

CVE-2026-110256.description: Finsys Dockhand through 1.0.18 contains an LDAP injection vulnerability in the tryLdapAuth function in src/lib/server/auth.ts, which inserts the login username into the LDAP search filter without escaping wildcard characters. Unauthenticated attackers can submit incremental wildcard patterns such as 'a*' to /api/auth/login and measure response timing to enumerate valid LDAP usernames while evading per-username rate limiting.

CVE-2026-49785.description: Improper resource shutdown or release in Windows UEFI allows an authorized attacker to bypass a security feature locally.

CVE-2026-54086.description: SLE API for Java is an implementation of CCSDS Space Link Extension Services. Prior to 5.1.7, the ISP1 PDU handling path decodes an attacker-controlled body length and allocates a byte array without an upper bound, while malformed or truncated input can also terminate reads unexpectedly, allowing an unauthenticated client of the SLE listening service to trigger exceptions, resource leakage, and denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 5.1.7.

CVE-2026-84994.description: Qwik is a performance-focused JavaScript framework. Prior to @builder.io/qwik 1.20.0 and @qwik.dev/core 2.0.0-beta.37, default server-side qwik-json deserialization causes ResourceSerializer.$fill$ to pass resource._resolved to Promise.resolve without first rejecting attacker-controlled thenables. An unauthenticated request can provide a plain object whose then property is a QRL for an unregistered symbol, causing an orphaned asynchronous rejection that terminates Node.js under its default unhandled-rejection policy. A single request can crash a server, and repeated requests can keep replicas unavailable. This issue is fixed in @builder.io/qwik 1.20.0 and @qwik.dev/core 2.0.0-beta.37.

CVE-2026-85747.description: Distribution is a toolkit to pack, ship, store, and deliver container content. The bundled pull-through proxy in registry/proxy/proxymanifeststore.go can cache and re-serve the substituted manifest. This issue is fixed in version 3.1.2.

CVE-2026-86063.description: Claude Code is an agentic coding tool. Prior to 2.1.179, the Claude Code and Claude Desktop plugin installation flow runs git checkout for a marketplace-pinned commit without verifying that the resulting HEAD equals the pinned 40-character SHA. An attacker who controls a plugin repository on a Git host that permits SHA-shaped branch names can create a branch named after the reviewed commit, causing checkout to select the branch tip and install attacker-controlled plugin code. Exploitation requires a user to install the malicious plugin and pin it to the ostensibly safe hash. This issue is fixed in version 2.1.179.

7a1bbecf4dda100a2e733f98.title_ko: 캐릭터닷AI 파산 신청 및 디즈니 자산 매각 추진
7a1bbecf4dda100a2e733f98.summary_ko: 캐릭터닷AI가 막대한 운영 비용과 법적 분쟁을 견디지 못하고 미국 파산법원에 파산보호 신청을 냈습니다. 회사는 사업 운영 기반을 유지하며 자산 매각을 진행할 계획이며, 디즈니가 지식재산권 인수를 위한 우선협상자로 참여했습니다.

e5f3f03d4df7fc62c5a4b884.title_ko: 중국 CXMT의 메모리 신기술 발표에 글로벌 반도체주 하락
e5f3f03d4df7fc62c5a4b884.summary_ko: 중국 창신메모리(CXMT)가 메모리 집적도를 높이는 4F 스퀘어 구조의 신기술을 발표하면서 글로벌 반도체 주가가 하락했습니다. 다만 업계에서는 양산 능력과 상용화 수준이 아직 검증되지 않았다는 지적도 나옵니다.

72583fb29cba2b4762d3143b.summary_ko: 핀텔은 자체 개발한 AI 영상분석 알고리즘과 PREVAX 플랫폼을 바탕으로 공공 및 국방 분야에서 사업을 확대하고 있습니다. 도시 운영 데이터를 판단과 실행까지 연결하는 풀스택 에이전틱 AI 플랫폼으로 글로벌 보안 시장을 공략할 계획입니다.

a7f19ddda0169d7bbb393eea.summary_ko: 애플이 크롬보다 강력하고 개인정보 보호에 유리한 브라우저로 사파리를 소개하는 새로운 캠페인 페이지와 유튜브 영상을 공개했습니다. 맥에서 크롬 대비 최대 5시간 더 긴 동영상 스트리밍 배터리 이점을 강조했습니다.

f94804e1b960640aaac4508b.title_ko: 정부 청사 신분증 스캐너 클라우드 침해로 출입 통제 무력화
f94804e1b960640aaac4508b.summary_ko: 정부 청사 정문의 신분증 스캐너와 연동된 외주 클라우드가 침해당해 위조 신분증에 의한 출입 통제 무력화 사고가 발생했습니다. 단일 이미지 검증을 탈피하고 오프라인 로컬 망 기반 다중 생체 교차 검증 도입이 시급한 상황입니다.

b05cde22f80d48c362aa6b29.title_ko: 프랑스 대형마트 500여 곳 사이버공격으로 냉장설비 마비 및 화재 발생
b05cde22f80d48c362aa6b29.summary_ko: 프랑스 전역의 대형마트 수백 곳이 사이버공격을 받아 냉장설비의 제상 기능이 악용되었고 내부 온도가 최대 50도까지 상승했습니다. 이로 인해 대규모 식품 폐기와 화재 피해가 발생하며 산업용 운영기술(OT) 보안의 취약성이 지적되었습니다.

94cb1d8dfb6fd666cafc04f9.title_ko: 쿠팡 개인정보 유출 과징금 불복소송 문제 제기
94cb1d8dfb6fd666cafc04f9.summary_ko: 더불어민주당 이훈기 의원이 쿠팡의 대규모 개인정보 유출 및 무단 수집 관련 과징금 처분 불복소송과 관련해 기업의 개인정보 보호 책임을 지적했다. 개인정보보호위원회는 쿠팡이 인증서명키 접근관리 미비 등 보안 관리체계 소홀로 대규모 유출을 초래했다고 판단해 과징금을 부과했다. 이에 쿠팡이 행정소송과 집행정지를 신청하면서 행정제재의 적정성을 둘러싼 법적 공방이 이어지고 있다.

ce5fe07add9f4c52fa876559.title_ko: 오픈AI 회의실에 도청장치 설치한 사우디 국적 직원 체포
ce5fe07add9f4c52fa876559.summary_ko: 미국 오픈AI의 사내 임원용 회의실에 비밀리에 녹음장치를 설치한 사우디아라비아 국적의 엔지니어가 불법 통신 감청 시도 혐의로 FBI에 체포됐다. 해당 직원은 챗봇에 도청기 제작 및 은닉 방법 등을 질의한 정황이 포착됐다. 오픈AI는 자체 AI 모델을 활용해 장치의 출처를 분석한 뒤 당국에 신고했으며, 현재까지 핵심 소스코드나 고객 데이터 유출 정황은 없는 것으로 전해졌다.

curation.reason_ko: 오픈AI 회의실에 불법 도청기를 설치하려던 사우디 국적 직원이 기소됐다.

806b2d100898293e595c5e51.title_ko: AI 시대 CISO, 개별 시스템 넘어 비즈니스 '광역 방어' 필요
806b2d100898293e595c5e51.summary_ko: AI 발전으로 공격자가 주변부 업무 채널의 취약점을 악용해 연쇄 침투하는 공격이 증가하면서 기존 지역 방어의 한계가 지적되고 있다. 금융권 등에서 주변 업무 서비스 인증 취약점을 노린 정보 유출 사고가 잇따라 발생했다. 정보보호최고책임자(CISO)는 기술 관리와 규정 준수를 넘어 전사적 비즈니스 가시성과 제로트러스트 기반의 광역 방어 체계를 구축해야 한다.

823f8f1d47132c722ee60819.title_ko: 뉴욕 고용시장에서 대졸자 실업률이 비대졸자 웃도는 '학위 역전' 발생
823f8f1d47132c722ee60819.summary_ko: 미국 뉴욕에서 20~20대 중반 청년층 중 대졸자의 실업률이 비대졸자보다 높아진 것으로 나타났다. 최소 15년 만에 처음 발생한 현상으로, 인공지능(AI)이 금융 및 IT 등 화이트칼라 직종에 영향을 미치기 시작한 신호라는 분석이 제기된다. 다만 적절한 대응이 이뤄질 경우 AI 관련 새로운 고용 창출 가능성도 함께 제기되고 있다.

c053f3a2ac443842dc621bf4.title_ko: 오에스비씨, AI 해킹·공급망 공격 대응 위한 외부 반입 파일 검증 체계 제시
c053f3a2ac443842dc621bf4.summary_ko: 오픈소스 보안 기업 오에스비씨가 최근 금융권의 잇따른 해킹 및 공급망 사고 대응을 위해 리버싱랩스의 반입 파일 검증 솔루션 공급에 나선다. AI 기반 자율 침투 공격과 외주 소프트웨어 취약점이 증가함에 따라, 소스코드 없이 바이너리 수준에서 외부 반입 파일의 무결성과 위·변조 여부를 사전 검증해야 한다고 강조했다. 이를 통해 공급망을 통한 악성코드 유입을 차단하고 보안 가시성을 높일 수 있다고 설명했다.

a43fad1ff614ceb0c1971699.title_ko: 휴먼인텍, 장정맥 인식 출입통제 '팜키' 라인업 확대 및 스마트 락커 '팜락' 공개
a43fad1ff614ceb0c1971699.summary_ko: 휴먼인텍이 손바닥 정맥 인식 출입통제시스템 '팜키'의 신규 라인업과 장정맥 기반 스마트 락커키 '팜락'을 선보였다. 적외선 센서로 위조가 어려운 내부 정맥 패턴을 비접촉 방식으로 인식하여 0.3초 이내에 본인 인증을 수행한다. 출입통제 중심의 보안 기술을 개인 보관함 및 고보안 시설 영역으로 확장하여 적용할 방침이다.

031320484368220155f44f40.summary_ko: 국제 해킹보안 컨퍼런스 POC2026이 오는 11월 12일부터 13일까지 서울 더 웨스턴 서울 파르나스에서 개최된다. 이번 행사는 윈도우 커널, iOS, 브라우저, AI 버그 헌팅 등 다양한 오펜시브 보안 연구 주제를 다룰 예정이다.

2452a2af2e58b9f846dfc636.summary_ko: Gemini 4 Argon은 물리 추론과 코드 생성, 시각적 의미 추론을 결합하여 로봇 제어부터 시뮬레이션 구축, 연구까지 지원하는 모델이다. 3D 환경의 물리적 공간 문제를 평가하는 ERQA 벤치마크에서 순수 추론으로 87%를 기록했다.

summary.summary_ko: 실제 엔지니어들을 위한 실무 기술과 에이전트 디렉토리 기반의 내용을 담고 있는 오픈소스 저장소입니다.
AI 코딩 에이전트를 위한 프로덕션 급 엔지니어링 기술과 모범 사례를 담은 저장소다. 개발자가 에이전트를 활용해 코딩 작업을 수행할 때 필요한 실용적인 방법론과 스킬을 제공한다.

summary.title_ko: 앱 동작부터 네이티브 바이너리까지 에이전트로 리버스 엔지니어링하는 도구
summary.summary_ko: 이 저장소는 인공지능 에이전트를 활용해 애플리케이션의 동작 분석부터 네이티브 바이너리 코드에 이르기까지 다양한 대상의 리버스 엔지니어링을 수행하는 도구를 제공한다.
PS5 실행 파일을 리눅스와 윈도우로 자동 포팅하기 위한 도구다.
클로드 코드, 코덱스, 깃허브 코파일럿 등을 위한 편집용 다이어그램 디자인 도구 저장소이다. 42가지 다이어그램 유형을 자체 포함된 HTML과 SVG 형식으로 제공한다.
Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor 등 다양한 AI 코딩 도구를 위한 44가지 편집용 다이어그램 디자인 저장소이다. HTML과 SVG 기반으로 독립 구동되며 깔끔한 시각화 자료를 제공한다.

summary.title_ko: 오픈소스 음성 복제 및 변환 도구 VoiceStudio
summary.summary_ko: VoiceStudio는 646개 언어를 지원하는 오픈소스 로컬 음성 복제 및 변환 도구다. 음성 디자인, 비디오 더빙, 받아쓰기, 오디오북 생성 기능을 제공한다.

summary.title_ko: 브라우저 기반 실시간 공간 정보 시뮬레이터
summary.summary_ko: 이 프로젝트는 실제 데이터를 기반으로 3D 지구본 위에서 실시간 오픈소스 공간 정보를 제공하는 브라우저 기반 시뮬레이터다. 현실적인 시각화와 공간 데이터 탐색 기능을 지원한다.

summary.title_ko: 크로스 플랫폼 Xcode 대체 도구 xtool
summary.summary_ko: xtool은 리눅스, 윈도우, 맥OS 환경에서 Swift 패키지 매니저를 이용해 iOS 앱을 빌드하고 배포할 수 있는 크로스 플랫폼 Xcode 대체 오픈소스 도구다.

summary.title_ko: 저사양 GPU에서 대형 언어 모델을 구동하는 AirLLM
summary.summary_ko: AirLLM은 단일 4GB GPU 환경에서도 2.8T 규모의 대형 언어 모델을 원활하게 추론할 수 있도록 지원하는 오픈소스 도구다. 저사양 하드웨어 제약을 극복하고 대형 모델을 실행할 수 있게 돕는다.
